get_encoder_from_files: load a GPT-2 BPE encoder from an encoder JSON and vocab BPE file path
encode_text_to_tokens: encode a string of text into a list of GPT-2 BPE token IDs
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of GPT-2 BPE token IDs back into a string of text
apply_bpe_merges: apply byte pair encoding merges to a token string using the Encoder bpe method
bytes_to_unicode_mapping: get a cached mapping of UTF-8 byte values to their corresponding Unicode strings
